title: Easy netherite
description: Make netherite tools and armour easy to craft like all the other armour and tools.
body:
Easily craft Netherite armor and tools just like any other gear! ⚒️✨ This datapack removes the hassle of using the smithing table and lets you create powerful Netherite equipment directly from simple crafting recipes using Netherite Ingots.

With full JEI support, all recipes are clearly displayed in your crafting interface, making it super convenient to see and craft your Netherite gear without any confusion. 📜🔍

Perfect for players who want the strength and durability of Netherite without the complicated upgrade process — enjoy seamless crafting and get ready to conquer the Nether with ease! 🔥🛡️
